decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already removes the trial-specific moment selection standard, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The same-message MODIFY already removes the permitted trial sources and trial topic constraint, fully representing the effect of ending the clip trial.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the clip trial with the screening-form qualification process and removes obsolete trial details.
Changing the qualification process and ending the trial-clip editing requirement does not alter the separately stated Lead Clipper advancement pathway.
